logline: When a frantic mother brings her critically ill child to the woodland cottage, Juliana successfully cures him with her mother's herbal remedies, unknowingly igniting dangerous rumors that reach the ears of the Blond Nobleman.
continuity_notes: Picks up immediately after Episode 8, continuing the peaceful evening inside the cottage before an urgent knock shatters the calm.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium close-up of Juliana at the wooden table by candlelight, grinding dried herbs with a pestle inside a stone mortar.

events.label: ACTION
events.content: Juliana methodically crushes herbs in the mortar beside her open herbal grimoire.

events.label: SOUND FX
events.content: Heavy, frantic pounding echoes against the heavy wooden cottage door.

events.label: ACTION
events.content: Juliana stops grinding and lifts her head sharply toward the entrance in alarm.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of Alexander turning toward the doorway, his eyes sharp and vigilant.

events.label: ALEXANDER (Authoritative, Protective)
events.content: "Stay back. I'll open it."

events.label: ACTION
events.content: Alexander steps forward and unlatches the cottage door, opening it into the pouring rain.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium shot framing the doorway as a soaked, distraught peasant mother steps across the threshold clutching a swaddled child.

events.label: PEASANT MOTHER (Frantic, Weeping)
events.content: "Please! They told me there was a woman here who knows herbs. My boy is burning with fever!"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium shot of Juliana rushing to the front of the table, extending her arms urgently.

events.label: JULIANA (Urgent, Compassionate)
events.content: "Bring him here. Quickly."

events.label: ACTION
events.content: The trembling mother gently lays the feverish boy down atop the wooden table as Juliana leans in close.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of Juliana gently placing her fingers against the boy's burning forehead.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium close-up of Juliana examining the boy's breathing, looking up toward the frantic mother.

events.label: JULIANA (Reassuring, Focused)
events.content: "He seems very unwell, but he is resting steadily. How long has he been like this?"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium two-shot of Alexander watching anxiously over the child's shoulder as Juliana tends to him.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium close-up of the peasant mother clutching her shawl, tears running down her cheeks.

events.label: PEASANT MOTHER (Trembling, Anxious)
events.content: "Since yesterday morning. He has barely eaten since sunset."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of Juliana resting two fingers against the boy's wrist, measuring his shallow pulse.

events.label: ACTION
events.content: Juliana lifts the weathered herbal book and rapidly browses the handwritten pages.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Insert close-up of the open page illustrated with botanical drawings labeled 'Feverfew'.

events.label: JULIANA (Muttering, Intent)
events.content: "Feverfew... Not alone."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Profile close-up of Juliana studying the grimoire's remedies intently while the mother weeps in the soft background.

events.label: JULIANA (Determined)
events.content: "Chamomile... and willow bark."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of Alexander leaning over the table, gazing at her with intense concern.

events.label: ALEXANDER (Grave)
events.content: "You're certain?"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of Juliana looking up into his eyes with resolute conviction.

events.label: JULIANA (Resolute)
events.content: "I have to be."

events.label: ACTION
events.content: Juliana quickly grabs bundles of dried herbs from the table and turns to Alexander.

events.label: JULIANA (Urgent)
events.content: "Alexander, I need hot water."

events.label: ALEXANDER (Prompt)
events.content: "I'm on it."

events.label: ACTION
events.content: Alexander hurries to the hearth and lifts a boiling iron kettle from the hearth chain, while the mother buries her face in her hands.

events.label: PEASANT MOTHER (Sobbing)
events.content: "Please save him."

events.label: ACTION
events.content: Alexander returns and pours steaming hot water into the stone mortar as Juliana prepares the remedy.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium close-up of Juliana clasping the mother's trembling hand across the wooden table.

events.label: JULIANA (Gentle, Steadfast)
events.content: "He is not beyond saving."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of Juliana carefully administering the herbal brew with a small wooden spoon into the sick boy's mouth.

events.label: ACTION
events.content: The child swallows weakly and lets out a soft cough.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of the mother clutching her chest in anxious suspense.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium close-up of Juliana sitting quietly beside the boy, holding two fingers over his wrist to monitor his pulse.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Over-the-shoulder shot from behind the mother leaning across the table in panic.

events.label: PEASANT MOTHER (Despairing)
events.content: "Why isn't it working?"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of Juliana raising a calm finger, urging patience.

events.label: JULIANA (Quiet, Focused)
events.content: "Wait."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of the sleeping boy as beads of sweat form on his forehead, his breathing deepening.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of the mother gently caressing her son's cheek, sobbing with relief.

events.label: PEASANT MOTHER (Overcome with Emotion)
events.content: "His fever... it's breaking."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of Juliana exhaling a deep breath of relief, smiling gently.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of the mother looking up at Juliana with overwhelming gratitude.

events.label: PEASANT MOTHER (Tearful, Grateful)
events.content: "You saved him."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium close-up of Juliana grasping the mother's hand with warm modesty.

events.label: JULIANA (Soft, Gracious)
events.content: "The herbs did their work. Let him rest."

events.label: ACTION
events.content: Juliana places a comforting hand over the mother's hands.

events.label: ACTION
events.content: The mother gathers her sleeping son in her arms and steps back toward the rainy doorway.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium shot from inside the cottage framing the mother standing at the open door looking back.

events.label: PEASANT MOTHER (Reverent, Vowing)
events.content: "I will tell the village what you did. They will never forget you."

events.label: ACTION
events.content: The mother exits into the rainy twilight as Alexander pushes the door shut.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of Alexander turning from the door, his expression deeply troubled.

events.label: ALEXANDER (Stern, Warning)
events.content: "You cannot let the whole village start talking about you."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium close-up of Juliana placing the mortar back onto the table, unflinching.

events.label: JULIANA (Defiant, Principled)
events.content: "A child's life matters more than gossip."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of Alexander, his jaw clenched with protective anxiety.

events.label: ALEXANDER (Dark, Cautionary)
events.content: "Gossip has a way of becoming dangerous."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium two-shot profile of Juliana stepping directly in front of Alexander, looking steadfastly up into his eyes.

events.label: JULIANA (Committed, Unshakable)
events.content: "Then we will face it together."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Wide shot of an opulent gothic manor study. The Blond Nobleman sits in a velvet armchair beside a roaring fireplace, reading an open leather-bound book.

events.label: ACTION
events.content: The Former Groom, soaked from the rain and clutching his hat, walks nervously through the double doors into the study.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium shot framing the Blond Nobleman in the foreground as The Former Groom halts respectfully behind his chair.

events.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Aloof, Without Looking Up)
events.content: "What is it?"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium close-up of The Former Groom, damp dark hair plastered to his forehead.

events.label: THE FORMER GROOM (Hesitant, Deferential)
events.content: "There is a rumor going around, my Lord."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of the Blond Nobleman lowering his book, gazing across with mild annoyance.

events.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Coldly Curious)
events.content: "What rumor?"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of The Former Groom speaking cautiously.

events.label: THE FORMER GROOM (Uneasy)
events.content: "About a war veteran. Some say he resembles the late Duke."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium close-up of the Blond Nobleman scoffing dismissively as he closes the book.

events.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Mocking, Arrogant)
events.content: "People see ghosts whenever they want a story."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Extreme close-up of The Former Groom's eyes widening with urgent dread.

events.label: THE FORMER GROOM (Tense, Solemn)
events.content: "The man is said to have the same kind of scar the Duke carried after the war."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of the Blond Nobleman snapping his head around, his smug expression freezing into sudden alarm.

events.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Sharp, Demanding)
events.content: "Where?"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium close-up of The Former Groom shifting uncomfortably.

events.label: THE FORMER GROOM (Cautious)
events.content: "No one seems certain."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of the Blond Nobleman composing his features into cold disdain, though tension trembles beneath his tone.

events.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Dismissive, Masking Panic)
events.content: "Then let it remain a rumor."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium shot as The Former Groom turns and retreats silently out of the study, leaving the doors closed.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Side profile shot of the Blond Nobleman seated alone before the roaring fire, staring blankly into the flames in creeping paranoia.

events.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Whispering, Shaken)
events.content: "Impossible."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Extreme close-up macro shot of the Blond Nobleman's eye, the flickering fireplace flames dancing across his widening iris as dark dread paralyzes him, holding until the screen cuts to black.

analysis_metadata.note: No invented LLM scene metadata; event-level evidence drives promo selection.
